chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality Ch. 516 – Han Li Eavesdrops on a Secret Escape Plan
chapter_meta_description: Han Li tails two cultivators to a secret meeting and overhears a desperate plot to bribe their way off the Sacred Mountain before the great war begins. A classic lesson in Mortal Stream information warfare.
og_title: Ch. 516: The Conspiracy in the Courtyard
og_description: Han Li spies on Foundation Establishment cultivators planning to escape the war by bribing a teleportation operator. No swords, just cold calculation.
twitter_title: AOMJI Ch. 516 – The Art of Listening
twitter_description: Han Li doesn't lift a sword—he just listens to desperate people talk, and walks away with the perfect escape plan.

lore_anchors.definition: A precarious threshold state just before Core Formation, where a cultivator’s mana peaks at Foundation Establishment but hasn’t yet solidified into a true Golden Core; many get stuck here for decades.
The dangerous, resource-rich frontier zone beyond the Inner Star Seas, where high-grade demon beasts and rare materials draw desperate cultivators willing to risk everything.
A low-grade warning array that detects intruders by sensing disturbances in an artificially circulated spiritual air current; easily bypassed by anyone with basic formation knowledge.
The middle residential tier of Heaven Star City’s tiered Sacred Mountain system, where mid-to-low-level cultivators are housed; distinct from the elite upper layers.
A major administrative hall on the Sacred Mountain, likely where teleportation permits and official Star Palace missions are handled.
A cultivator’s non-physical perception ability; at Han Li’s Foundation Establishment level, it can envelop a courtyard and distinguish individual presences within.
